name: All-Over Print Quilted Tote Bag
description:
Premium Material:
  • Made from high-quality polyester with soft quilted padding, the all-over Print Quilted Tote Bag offers a soft, lightweight, and durable construction for everyday use. 
  • The padded quilted texture enhances comfort while providing extra protection for your belongings. 
  • The material is designed to resist daily wear and maintain vibrant printed colors over time.

 

Sizes & Dimensions:

Available in multiple sizes to fit different carrying needs:
• Size S: 12.6 × 15.75 × 3.94 in (32 × 40 × 10 cm)
• Size M: 14.96 × 12.6 × 3.94 in (38 × 32 × 10 cm)
• Size L: 16.93 × 14.96 × 3.94 in (43 × 38 × 10 cm)
• Size XL: 18.9 × 13.78 × 3.94 in (48 × 35 × 10 cm)

 

Printing Technology:

Designed with sublimation printing technology that produces vivid colors, detailed artwork, and long-lasting print quality. The printing process ensures your personalized designs remain bright and visually appealing after regular use.

 

Functionality Use:

This versatile tote bag is ideal for carrying books, groceries, work essentials, travel items, laptops, daily necessities, or personal accessories. Its spacious interior and comfortable handles make it suitable for shopping trips, school, work, commuting, beach outings, or everyday use.

 

Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
A practical and personalized gift choice for birthdays, Mother's Day, Teacher Appreciation events, holidays, Christmas, anniversaries, or special celebrations. Perfect for family members, friends, coworkers, or anyone who appreciates stylish and functional accessories.

 

Specification:

  • Shipping Time: 7 – 15 working days average (US)
guideLine:
Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
